title: Zamboanga Sibugay POGO trafficking victims brought to Manila

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – A military aircraft transported Wednesday morning 51 human trafficking victims rescued during the twin raids on illegal Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO) hubs in Zamboanga Sibugay last week. The Philippine Air Force (PAF) flight carrying 49 Chinese nationals, one Cambodian, and one Filipina took off from the Pagadian City Airport at around 8:30 a.m. The air transport was initially scheduled for Tuesday afternoon but was cancelled after severe weather prevented the PAF plane from safely landing on the Pagadian airport runway.
